text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh...! That Buena Vista girl is
every bit as good as the rumors said...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
M-Man, next year's Tiara route is gonna be—
Huh, are you looking this way?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you so much!
I could hear all your cheers loud and clear!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Next year, at the Oka Sho... I hope to see everyone again.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be waiting for you to cheer just as loud
when that time comes!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text: Hey, look at me right now...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text: ...I'm telling you, it's definitely for me!

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text:
...Buena-chaaan!
Give it your all on the Tiara route too--!!

Undeterred by the earlier trouble or the massive G1 stage,
Buena Vista captured the hearts of the crowd with a magnificent performance.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Great work out there, Buena Vista-san!
Man, you really have some incredible legs on you...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Thank you!
Even at the post-race press conference, praise was showered upon her. Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
By the way, I heard there was some trouble
before entering the racecourse...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: "If she had been unable to run, it would have been a great loss to the racing world. What are your thoughts on this, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: Of course, it's all my responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Trainer-san—
choice_data_list: I was really saved by her strength this time.

text_block_list.text:
"I should have anticipated a wider range of possibilities.
While expressing my regrets, I touch upon how incredible
Buena Vista was for running through the race in this state."
choice_data_list: She really is an amazing Uma Musume

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: ...There's no pride in having to be saved by an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Um. You're that reporter...
You came to interview me before, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for always
caring about my future...!
I truly appreciate it!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, y-yes...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's why I really want you to know too.
Just what a wonderful person my Trainer is.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“—Because the reason I was able to grow strong
was having you by my side, Trainer.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So much... so very much.
Every day, from early morning to late at night...
You were constantly thinking about what's best for me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Always keeping that same, steady stance.
It was from you, Trainer, that I learned what it means to do my best.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
With my Trainer supporting me, who understands me better than anyone...
I will believe in myself and run all the way to the end.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...We're bound by deep trust,
my Trainer is my absolute pride!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Right?
choice_data_list: ...No, she's the very model of hard work—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Doing that again...――

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
...Haha. I see, my apologies.
The two of you are bound by... "trust," aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
You know, those two...
make a pretty good pair.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: "Indeed. No points of concern for Buena Vista, huh? In that case... she might just pull it off."

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: The crowning of the third Triple Tiara winner in history is within reach...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "...About what I said in the interview earlier."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I really mean it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're blushing.
...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hey, next up at last...
The Classic races are finally starting.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The first leg of the Tiara route,
the Oka Sho...!

The Oka Sho... Contested over 1,600 meters at Hanshin Racecourse, just like today.
For Buena Vista after today's race—
choice_data_list: You can take it on with confidence.
You can take it on with confidence, can't you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yup.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Let's keep growing... "together"! For next year, okay?

Looking ahead to next year's Oka Sho...
Let's refresh our spirits and move forward with preparations.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista was amazing, wasn't she—
—I wonder what Buena-chan will do next—
Is she the favorite for the Tiara route—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-san—I knew it, it's true.
You truly are my..."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
You have my gratitude.
For entrusting her with the trial needed to reach 'that place.'

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us begin.
—My tale to prove my worth as a Saint.
